AxisPositioning.description: CRAFT Section 10. One axis's positioning, naming which CRAFT condition it serves and where it sits in the domain configuration.

position.description: Where this axis sits within the domain configuration.

serves_condition.description: Which CRAFT condition this axis serves.

AxisPositioning.title: AxisPositioning

BackgroundState.description: CRAFT Section 10, element 4. The background state of a declared inheritance. Silence is not one of the values.
BackgroundState.title: BackgroundState

ChainLevelReceipt.description: CRAFT Section 10. The chain-level receipt component, the chain specification in CRAFT-compliant form, traceable to the six conditions.

decision_context.description: Condition 1. The decision context of the chain specification.

domain_configuration.description: The specific structural facts that constitute this domain's instantiation of CRAFT.

technical_ontology.description: Condition 2. The technical ontology of the chain specification.

ChainLevelReceipt.title: ChainLevelReceipt

ComplianceRecordType.description: CRAFT Section 12.3. The compliance report's declared type.
ComplianceRecordType.title: ComplianceRecordType

ComplianceReport.description: CRAFT Section 12.3. Whether a specification document meets CRAFT requirements, produced at audit time (not when the chain evaluates data). Each finding declares its layer, so a domain-application finding is distinguishable from a CRAFT base finding.

condition_results.description: CRAFT Section 12.3. One result per condition, each declaring its layer.

evaluated_specification_id.description: CRAFT Section 12.3. Which specification document was evaluated.

evaluated_specification_version.description: CRAFT Section 12.3. The version of that specification.

record_type.description: Declared so an automated consumer never infers the document type.

ComplianceReport.title: ComplianceReport

ConditionFinding.description: CRAFT Section 12.2. One condition's result at evaluation time, with its basis and layer attribution. A rejection finding without layer attribution cannot be used for root cause analysis, because the propagation target at Condition 6 depends on whether the failure originates at the CRAFT base or the domain application layer.

basis.description: The basis on which the result was reached.

condition.description: Which of the six conditions this finding concerns.

layer.description: CRAFT Section 12.2. Which layer's specification produced this finding.

result.description: The result of evaluating this condition on this input.

uncertainty_band.description: CRAFT Section 12.2 and Condition 3. The instrument uncertainty band, where Condition 3 specified one for the instrument producing this finding, so the outcome against the Condition 4 threshold is independently checkable.

ConditionFinding.title: ConditionFinding

ConditionResult.description: CRAFT Section 12.3. One condition's compliance result, with its layer attribution.

basis.description: The basis on which compliance was determined.

compliant.description: Whether the specification meets this condition's requirement.

condition.description: Which of the six conditions this result concerns.

layer.description: CRAFT Section 12.3. Whether the finding concerns a CRAFT base, domain-application, or per-axis quality requirement.

ConditionResult.title: ConditionResult

CraftCondition.description: CRAFT Section 5. The six conditions an evaluation chain must satisfy.
CraftCondition.title: CraftCondition

DeclaredInheritance.description: CRAFT Section 10. One declared inheritance with its five required elements. The activity profile converts the receipt from a static declaration into an operational specification. Background-unchecked is not a valid operating state; it must appear as a finding in any compliance review.

applicable_obligations.description: Element 2. Which of the standard's obligations apply to this domain application and what they require.

background_state.description: Element 4. Background-satisfied with a dated reference, or background-unchecked declared as a current gap.

background_validated_date.description: Element 4. Where background-satisfied, the date satisfaction was last validated.

foregrounding_triggers.description: Element 3. The contexts in which this standard's obligations become active demands.

standard_version.description: Element 1. The specific version against which obligations are declared.

version_coupling_procedure.description: Element 5. The procedure for detecting when this standard revises and the named response (entering version-bump-pending and triggering a Condition 6 event at the specification layer).

DeclaredInheritance.title: DeclaredInheritance

EvaluationOutcome.description: CRAFT Section 12.2. The outcome against the Condition 4 threshold carrying the Condition 3 uncertainty. Indeterminate is its own outcome class, not collapsible into accepted or rejected.
EvaluationOutcome.title: EvaluationOutcome

EvaluationRecord.description: CRAFT Section 12.2. What the chain did with one input at one point in time. One record per evaluation instance. Carries the outcome against the Condition 4 threshold with the Condition 3 instrument uncertainty, the per-condition findings with their layer attribution, and the propagation targets a non-accept outcome must feed back.

condition_findings.description: CRAFT Section 12.2. For each condition evaluated, the result, the basis, and the layer attribution; with the uncertainty band where Condition 3 specified one.

evaluation_timestamp.description: CRAFT Section 12.2. Date and time of evaluation.

gate_check_result.description: CRAFT Section 12.2 and 7.1. The adversarial gate result at evaluation time.

input_provenance.description: CRAFT Section 12.2. A reference to the input in sufficient form to allow the finding to be checked independently.

outcome.description: CRAFT Section 12.2. Accepted, rejected, or indeterminate, derived from the reading evaluated against the Condition 4 threshold carrying the Condition 3 uncertainty. Indeterminate is not collapsible into accepted or rejected.

propagation_targets.description: CRAFT Section 12.2. For rejection and indeterminate outcomes, the prior condition(s) the signal must propagate to under Condition 6. An indeterminate outcome propagates as its own signal class.

record_type.description: CRAFT Section 12.2. Declared so an automated consumer never infers the document type.

specification_id.description: CRAFT Section 12.2. The specification document in force at evaluation time.

specification_version.description: CRAFT Section 12.2. The exact version of that specification.

EvaluationRecord.title: EvaluationRecord

InheritanceReceipt.description: CRAFT Section 10. The formal declaration a CRAFT-conformant domain application produces: the chain-level receipt, the full Precision Toolkit scope (CSIS standards and Frame Language discipline, not CRAFT alone), and the activity profile for each declared inheritance. A receipt that declares CRAFT conformance without also declaring CSIS and Frame Language inheritance is structurally incomplete.

axis_positioning.description: CRAFT Section 10. Where a domain application implements per-axis quality assessment, which CRAFT condition each axis serves and where it sits in the domain configuration.

chain_level_receipt.description: CRAFT Section 10. The decision context, technical ontology, and domain configuration in CRAFT-compliant form, traceable to Conditions 1 through 6.

domain_application.description: The domain application this receipt is for.

precision_toolkit_scope.description: CRAFT Section 10. The declared inheritances (CSIS standards and Frame Language), each with its activity profile. Declaring CRAFT alone is structurally incomplete.

InheritanceReceipt.title: InheritanceReceipt

LayerAttribution.description: CRAFT Section 12. The architectural layer a finding concerns, preserved so the hierarchy is not flattened.
LayerAttribution.title: LayerAttribution

PropagationTarget.description: CRAFT Section 12.2 and Condition 6. One prior condition a non-accept signal propagates to, with the signal class it carries.

signal_class.description: The signal class propagated (for an indeterminate outcome, the non-resolution signal class distinct from a rejection).

target_condition.description: The prior condition the signal propagates to.

PropagationTarget.title: PropagationTarget
